changes.comment: HttpTreeAccessors accepts contentEncoding: 'base64' to request byte-faithful file contents and seeds its in-memory tree with the decoded bytes, which makes getFileBytes() honest and the optional strict-text capability decidable over HTTP. Defaults to utf8 (unchanged). The client branches on the response's encoding field, never on its own request, so a server that ignores the parameter degrades to text rather than corrupting every file.
